taps.text:
Taps
• Weather row → /weather
• A headline → that article
• ‹ › → previous / next news category (wraps round)
• Watchlist → /stocks
• Refresh icon → update now
Everything opens in your installed Happening Now app.

data.text:
Where the data comes from
The phone fetches it directly, same as the website: Open-Meteo for weather, our Worker for feeds and quotes. Nothing new reaches our server. Refreshes about every 30 min (Android's floor), plus the refresh icon.

setup.text:
Setup
On the Today page, tap "Send to phone widget". Your location, categories and watchlist hop to the widget app in one tap. Change them on the site, send again.
